title: ART3LIST
tagline: App especifically created for artists or art galleries. Log in with wallet and be able to view a list of NY galleries, select them, and add a new one through a contract.
description:
App especifically created for artists or art galleries. Log in with wallet and be able to view a list of NY galleries, select them, and add a new one through a contract, wanted to keep it simple as this is a team of one.

The app uses Wallet Connect for authentication of users, XDC Blockchain so that we have faster transactions on the blockchain. 
If user is an artist is able to view the whole list and tick those he/she has visited, in the future a new poap, NFT, discounts would be provided depending on the visits they have. 
Would be a work in community with Art world and Web3.

The main insight of the app is to start moving from Web2 to Web3 with real case scenarios and applications for a normal pedestrian.
how_its_made: After I was sure what the main idea and target of the new product was, depending on the technologies present on the ETHGlobal NY offering bounties I started creating the UI in Figma which is also attached on the repos. This helped understand better the project and once done that started working in a NextJS frontend which is now deployed In GitHub Pages, then once that basic functionalities and styles were ready I added authentication using Wallet Connect and calling the wallet id to get the user info and hence validating the contract for selected/viewed galleries.
